title: Fear & Greed as a neutral CNN style half-circle gauge; S&P 500 stale-cache fix
changes: The Fear & Greed tile shows a half-circle gauge in one neutral tone: five bands in CNN proportions, the active band dark, a needle at the exact value, and the number with the rating beside it
S&P 500 stayed empty because the cached Fear & Greed answer from the previous version had no S&P data; the cache key is now anav.fng.v3 and an entry without S&P data is ignored
